pageConfidentialite.title: Privacy Policy
pageConfidentialite.intro: This policy explains, without jargon, what data Adullam Global collects, why, who we share it with, how long we keep it and how to exercise your rights. It draws on the principles of the GDPR and international data protection good practice.
summary: We collect only what is needed to process your orders, secure the platform and improve the service.
We do not sell your data.
Your payment is processed by our provider: we neither see nor store your card or Mobile Money details.
Advertising tools (Meta) are activated only with your consent.
You can ask for access, correction or deletion of your data by email: reply within one month.

pageAbout.title: About us
pageAbout.intro: Adullamarket lets buyers in Africa order directly from manufacturers, with payment in local currency and delivery to their door. We handle the whole chain: purchase from the supplier, international transport and delivery.

i: You choose your products and your transport mode (sea, air or express).
You pay by Mobile Money or bank card, in your local currency.
We confirm the order with the supplier within 5 days at most.
The parcel travels: 45 to 50 days by sea, 15 to 20 days by air, 7 to 10 days by express.
You receive a tracking number by email as soon as it ships and you follow the order from your account.

r: Final price, delivery and customs included
Transport mode and estimated lead time
Product page, cart and payment page

i: Photo search: you send a photo, we analyse the image and suggest similar products from the catalogue.

Adu, the shopping assistant: an artificial intelligence that answers your questions, helps you compare and prepare your order. Adu can be wrong: only the information shown on the product page, in the cart and at payment binds us.
Recommendations: we use the products you view or add to your cart to suggest items. The data used is detailed in the [privacy policy](/confidentialite).
Custom sourcing: for a product you cannot find, you send us a request and we reply with an offer.

pageCgv.title: Terms and Conditions of Sale
pageCgv.intro: These terms and conditions of sale (T&C) set the rules between Adullam Global and you for any order placed on adullamarket.com or in the Adullam app. They are written to be read: please take a few minutes to go through them before ordering.
summary: Adullam Global sells you the products, buys them from the supplier and arranges transport to you.
The total shown at payment is the final price: products, delivery, customs duties and taxes included. Nothing to pay on delivery.
The order is confirmed within 5 days at most after payment, then transport takes 45 to 50 days by sea, 15 to 20 days by air or 7 to 10 days by express.
If your order does not arrive within the maximum time, you are refunded in full, delivery included.
A paid order cannot be cancelled, and products are not taken back for a simple change of mind.

sections.title: Who we are and who these T&C apply to

blocks.x: The website adullamarket.com (the "Website") and the Adullam mobile app (the "App") are published by Adullam Global ("Adullam", "we"), a company currently being incorporated in the United States. The "Customer" is any adult who places an order.

Until incorporation is completed, the registration number and official address are not published. They will be added to the [legal notice](/mentions-legales) as soon as they are available. Our only contact channel is contact@adullamarket.com.
By placing an order, you declare that you have read and accepted these T&C.

Adullamarket lists products offered by manufacturers and suppliers located in China, Turkey, Dubai and the United States, among others. Adullam sells these products to the Customer, buys them from the supplier, and arranges their international transport and delivery.

i: Catalogue: each product page shows the price, specifications, the minimum order quantity (MOQ) when there is one, and the available variants.
Custom sourcing: for a product that is not in the catalogue, you send a request and we reply with an offer. The contract is formed only when you accept the offer and pay for it.
Help tools: the Adu assistant, photo search and recommendations are described in article 13.
You must be an adult and provide accurate information (name, email, delivery address, recipient phone number).
You protect your password. Any action taken from your account is deemed to be yours, unless you tell us without delay about unauthorised access.
We may suspend or close an account in case of fraud, abuse or breach of these T&C.

blocks.x: Photos and descriptions come from suppliers and are indicative: slight differences in colour, size or finish are possible. The minimum quantities and variants displayed apply to the order.

Availability is checked when the order is confirmed with the supplier (article 7). If a product turns out to be unavailable, we tell you and refund you in full, unless you accept an alternative we offer.

Prices are set in US dollars (USD). They are displayed in your local currency (42 currencies) for information, based on a conversion rate kept up to date by Adullam. The exact amount to pay, in the payment currency, is shown before confirmation: that amount prevails.
The total shown at payment includes the price of the products, delivery costs, and customs duties and taxes. We ask for no extra payment on delivery.
blocks.title: Final price

blocks.x: Any fees charged by your Mobile Money operator or your bank are not included and remain your responsibility. In case of an obvious pricing error, we may cancel the order concerned and refund you in full.

Delivery costs are calculated from the weight and volume of the products, the transport mode chosen and the destination country. If you choose door-to-door delivery, it is charged only once for the whole cart.

i: You build your cart, choose a transport mode and check the total.
You pay by Mobile Money or bank card, through our payment provider (GeniusPay).
You receive a payment confirmation email with your order number.
We then confirm the order with the supplier (article 7).

blocks.x: The order becomes binding as soon as payment is confirmed. Adullam neither sees nor keeps your card data or Mobile Money credentials.

We may refuse or cancel an order, with a full refund, in case of suspected fraud, a product that is prohibited or subject to authorisation for import into the destination country, or an address we do not serve.
After payment, Adullam confirms the order with the supplier within 5 days at most. The transport lead time starts from that confirmation.
These are estimates. They may be extended by customs checks, weather, strikes or any event beyond our control. The estimated lead time is shown before payment.

Products in the same order are grouped by transport mode. An order may therefore result in several parcels, delivered on different dates depending on the mode. The delivery costs shown at payment cover the whole order.
You receive a tracking number by email as soon as the order ships, and you can follow your order from your account.

i: You must give an accurate delivery address and recipient phone number. A parcel returned because of incorrect information may lead to re-shipping costs.
